note: Novo Banco's standard information sheet for its Verde VISA credit card (07/2026): a nominal annual rate of 13.900%, and a yearly card fee of 13.00 euros plus 4% stamp duty on it, 13.52 in all; the stamp duty on interest and on credit isn't written.
